title: Lapsus$ member Arion Kurtaj sentenced to seven years and released the same day, Evening Standard reports
date_note: Source page was published on 23 November and says the sentence was handed down on Monday (23 November); it gives no earlier day.
geo_basis: Woolwich Crown Court, where the source says the sentence was passed
summary: The Evening Standard (via AOL) reports that Arion Kurtaj, described as a member of the Lapsus$ hacking gang who hacked companies including Rockstar, was sentenced to seven years at Woolwich Crown Court on Monday and released the same day. It says the judge decided his hospital stay and time on remand were long enough. He also received a five-year Serious Crime Prevention Order barring him from Discord and Telegram.
plain: A UK court sentenced hacker Arion Kurtaj to seven years, but the Evening Standard reports he was released the same day because the judge decided his time in hospital and on remand was long enough.
exec: A court case tied to the Rockstar hack ended in a seven-year sentence; the Evening Standard says he was released the same day.

sources.name: Evening Standard via AOL UK (23 November 2026)

validation.note: Only the AOL UK copy of the Evening Standard article was read; the Standard's own page could not be opened by the fetch tool, and no court or CPS page was read.

review.note: wording vs source: page says released the same day, record said could be released; fixed title, summary, plain, exec
